en.answer: The second effect of <<12672>> can be activated when a Spell Card is activated that targets 1 monster on your field, and can be any monster on your field along with <<12672>>.
en.question: Can the effect of <<12672>> that negates the activation of a Spell Card only be activated against a Spell Card that targets <<12672>> itself?
en.title: Can the effect of <<12672>> that negates the activation of a Spell Card only be activated against a Spell Card that targets <<12672>> itself?
